evals.name: document-stage-discount-requote
evals.prompt: The selected package is final. Add a 10% discount and make the PDF.
evals.expected_output: The skill prepares a 10% whole-package temporary request, calls calculate_temporary_quote_units, replaces raw_quote.json, renormalizes, renders, and verifies copied Core values.

assertions.name: requote
assertions.check: calculate_temporary_quote_units is called with temporary_discount on every unit

assertions.name: authoritative-result
assertions.check: the new MCP response replaces raw_quote.json before normalization

assertions.name: no-local-discount
assertions.check: apply_adjustments.py is not used and no discount amount or total is calculated locally

evals.name: unsupported-greeter-fee
evals.prompt: Add a $150 greeter fee and waive the fuel surcharge on this quote.
evals.expected_output: The plugin clearly explains that these monetary changes are unsupported, keeps Core pricing unchanged, and may add a non-priced operational note for the greeter.

assertions.name: no-mutation
assertions.check: raw_quote.json and all monetary values remain unchanged

assertions.name: clear-boundary
assertions.check: the response does not imply the unsupported fee or waiver is included

evals.name: zero-value-preservation
evals.prompt: Build an export from the attached exact result, which legitimately contains zero-valued rates and totals.
evals.expected_output: Zero values remain zero, no fallback value is substituted, and verification compares directly with the raw result.

assertions.name: presence-copy
assertions.check: valid zero fields are present in normalized output

assertions.name: direct-verification
assertions.check: verification does not sum line totals to derive aggregate_total
